peek_left.note: lean left, head only past the corner

locker_lean.note: route locker inspection: bent in at the slats from the waist, face looking straight in

corner_peek_left.note: route corner peek: head and most of the chest past the edge, feet behind it

press_glass.note: palms on the glass, leaning in

flinch.note: hands up against the light, one-shot

sit.note: seated on a chair or bench

listen.note: head cocked, hand to the ear

vent_crawl_verrine.note: belly-low hands-and-knees shuffle for vent shafts

vent_drop_verrine.note: drop from standing to the crawl (one-shot)

vent_rise_verrine.note: rise from the crawl to standing (one-shot)
